html: Our work on airport terminal passenger queue forecasting received the Best Paper of Session Award at DASC 2026.
I started my Ph.D. in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering at George Washington University, advised by Prof. Peng Wei.
I gave a talk at the Department of Civil, Urban and Environmental Engineering at Seoul National University on aircraft trajectory modeling and prediction.
I presented our work on air traffic complexity estimation using radar imagery at the ATRS World Conference 2026.
Our paper Multi-Agent Inverted Transformer for Flight Trajectory Prediction was accepted to IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems.
Our work on Probabilistic Multi-Agent Aircraft Landing Time Prediction received the Best Student Paper Award in Intelligent Systems at AIAA SciTech 2026.
Our paper Aircraft Trajectory Dataset Augmentation in Latent Space was accepted to the International Journal of Aeronautical and Space Sciences.
Our work on Learning to Explain Air Traffic Situation was presented at the US-Europe Air Transportation Research & Development Symposium.
Our paper Aircraft Trajectory Prediction with Inverted Transformer was accepted to IEEE Access.
Our research on real-time UAM fleet rebalancing received the Best Paper of Session Award at DASC 2024.
I received my M.S. in Air Transportation from Korea Aerospace University.
Our work on integrated UAM operations at airports received the Best Paper of Session Award at DASC 2023.
I received the President's Award at Korea Aerospace University for placing first in the Graduate Research Competition.
I obtained my Air Traffic Controller License from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, Republic of Korea.
I received the Brain Korea 21 Plus (BK21+) Research Scholarship.
